tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Record a durable, generalized taste reaction in the structured Taste profile. Use only when the user's feedback is a standing preference that should apply again later. Do not use for one-off constraints, explicit instructions limited to this task, or contentless praise.

dimension_id.description: Taste dimension id, such as writing, music, web-design, or interior-design.

axis_id.description: Specific seeded axis id within the dimension.

direction.description: Which side of the axis the durable preference favors.

strength.description: nudge for a modest signal, clear for an unambiguous repeated or strongly stated preference.

reason.description: Short generalized reason, phrased as the preference rather than a transcript of the event.
